Liberty have to take care of the ball and have to get their bigs going vs. switches.

items.title: At the half: New York 40, Atlanta 37.
items.author: Alexa Philippou
items.body_excerpt:
At the half: New York 40, Atlanta 37. 

Pretty tight game so far. NY shooting better overall and is winning the battle down low, but has committed 10 TOs. ATL found some success from the 3-point line (6-15).

Sabrina Ionescu, DeWanna Bonner lead their teams with 12 points apiece.
